mapper.select: SELECT pr.ref_index as refId, pr.raw_text as rawText, gr.title, gr.abstract as paperAbstract, gr.citation_count AS citationCount, gr.linked_paper_id as linkedPaperId FROM paper_references pr JOIN global_references gr ON pr.global_ref_id = gr.id WHERE pr.paper_id = #{paperId} AND pr.ref_index = #{refIndex}
